
In conclusion,
CONTRAfluran canisters recaptured about `r round(recovery_pct_final, 0)`% of the sevoflurane used
under routine clinical conditions.
This is roughly half of what is theoretically possible at minimal fresh gas flows.
Reducing sevoflurane use remains the priority.
CONTRAfluran and other vapour capture technologies
can only recover part of the volatile anaesthetic
that leaves the exhaust port of the anaesthesia machine.
